description.en: Performs trend analysis on river-flux and marine water-chemistry time series using Mann-Kendall tests and Sen's slope estimation. Supports monthly, annual and season-specific analyses, with configurable minimum observation requirements, analysis periods and significance levels. River and marine data are aggregated by time period before trend testing, and marine annual aggregation can require observations from all four seasons.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Optional list of water-chemistry variable names to include in the trend analysis. If omitted, the variables specified in the AquaINFRA trend configuration are used.

variable_units.title: Variable units
variable_units.description: Optional list of variable=unit pairs specifying the measurement unit for each variable, for example 'DOC=mg/L'. If omitted, no explicit unit overrides are provided.

non_mass_vars.title: Non-mass variables
non_mass_vars.description: List of variables that are not mass concentrations, such as colour, absorbance, temperature and salinity. These variables are excluded from mass-based unit conversions. Default: Color, UV_Abs_254nm, UV_Abs_410nm, CDOM_abs_443, SSS, SST, secchi_depth, Chl-a.

urls_rivers_daily_flux.title: River flux files
urls_rivers_daily_flux.description: Optional list of HTTP(S) URLs pointing to daily river-flux NetCDF files used as input for trend analysis. At least one URL must be provided when this input is used. If omitted, no external river-flux files are specified.

url_marine_chemistry.title: Marine input
url_marine_chemistry.description: Optional URL of the marine water-chemistry NetCDF dataset used for trend analysis. Supports HTTP(S) and OPeNDAP access. If omitted, no external marine dataset is specified.

trend_frequency.title: Trend frequency
trend_frequency.description: Temporal frequency for Mann-Kendall trend analysis. Use 'config' to run all frequencies specified in the internal configuration (monthly, annual and seasonal_by_season). Alternatively, select one frequency. Default: config.

mk_mode.title: Mann-Kendall mode
mk_mode.description: Mann-Kendall test mode. 'auto' uses the seasonal Mann-Kendall test for monthly data and the original Mann-Kendall test for annual data. Seasonal-by-season analyses use the original test for each season. 'original' and 'seasonal' allow explicit selection for monthly and annual analyses. Default: auto.

trend_start_year.title: Trend start year
trend_start_year.description: Optional first year of the trend-analysis period. If not specified, the analysis period is determined from the available data. Default: not specified.

trend_end_year.title: Trend end year
trend_end_year.description: Optional last year of the trend-analysis period. If not specified, the analysis period is determined from the available data. Default: not specified.

trend_require_full_period.title: Require full trend period
trend_require_full_period.description: Whether the aggregated trend series must cover both boundary years of the requested analysis period. If true, series that do not reach the specified start and end years are marked as insufficient data. Default: true.

trend_alpha.title: Trend significance level
trend_alpha.description: Significance level (alpha) used for the Mann-Kendall trend test. Must be greater than 0 and less than 1. Default: 0.05.

trend_min_points_monthly.title: Minimum points for monthly trends
trend_min_points_monthly.description: Minimum number of valid monthly aggregated values required to perform the Mann-Kendall trend test. Must be a positive integer. Default: 36.

trend_min_points_annual.title: Minimum points for annual trends
trend_min_points_annual.description: Minimum number of valid annual aggregated values required to perform the Mann-Kendall trend test. Must be a positive integer. Default: 10.

trend_min_points_seasonal.title: Minimum points for seasonal trends
trend_min_points_seasonal.description: Minimum number of valid seasonal aggregated values required to perform the Mann-Kendall trend test separately for each season. Must be a positive integer. Default: 10.

river_min_obs_monthly.title: River: minimum observations per month
river_min_obs_monthly.description: Minimum number of valid daily river observations required to calculate a monthly aggregated value for trend analysis. Must be a positive integer. Default: 25.

river_min_obs_annual.title: River: minimum observations per year
river_min_obs_annual.description: Minimum number of valid daily river observations required to calculate an annual aggregated value for trend analysis. Must be a positive integer. Default: 330.

river_min_obs_seasonal.title: River: minimum observations per season
river_min_obs_seasonal.description: Minimum number of valid daily river observations required to calculate a seasonal aggregated value for trend analysis. Must be a positive integer. Default: 80.

marine_depth_min.title: Marine minimum depth
marine_depth_min.description: Minimum sampling depth in metres for selecting marine observations used in trend analysis. Default: 0 m.

marine_depth_max.title: Marine maximum depth
marine_depth_max.description: Maximum sampling depth in metres for selecting marine observations used in trend analysis. Default: 10 m.

marine_min_obs_monthly.title: Marine: minimum observations per month
marine_min_obs_monthly.description: Minimum number of valid marine observations within a month required for monthly aggregation. Default: 1.

marine_min_obs_annual.title: Marine: minimum observations per year
marine_min_obs_annual.description: Minimum number of valid marine observations within a year required for annual aggregation. Additional seasonal coverage requirements may apply. Default: 1.

marine_min_obs_seasonal.title: Marine: minimum observations per season
marine_min_obs_seasonal.description: Minimum number of valid marine observations within a season required for seasonal aggregation. Default: 3.

marine_require_all_seasons.title: Marine: require all seasons
marine_require_all_seasons.description: Whether marine observations must cover all four seasons of a year for annual aggregation. Default: true.

marine_min_seasons_per_year.title: Marine: minimum seasons per year
marine_min_seasons_per_year.description: Minimum number of distinct seasons with valid marine observations required within a year for annual aggregation. Must be an integer between 0 and 4. Default: 4.

marine_station_dim.title: Marine station dimension
marine_station_dim.description: Name of the station dimension in the input marine NetCDF dataset. Default: station.

marine_station_coord.title: Marine station coordinate
marine_station_coord.description: Name of the station-name coordinate in the input marine NetCDF dataset. Default: station_name.

marine_depth_dim.title: Marine depth dimension
marine_depth_dim.description: Name of the depth dimension or coordinate in the input marine NetCDF dataset. Default: depth.

combined_trends.title: Trend analysis results (Excel)
combined_trends.description: Mann-Kendall trend and Sen's slope results for the selected stations, variables and time periods
